attributes.text:
PlugBrain uses the Accessibility service to see which app is open. When you open an app you chose to block, or a calculator during a challenge, PlugBrain shows a math challenge first.

PlugBrain only reads the app's name. It doesn't read what's on your screen or what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
